The B-52 Stratofortress remains one of the most powerful bombers ever built, even decades after its first flight. Continuous upgrades to engines, weapons systems, and avionics have transformed this Cold War icon into a modern strike platform capable of delivering devastating firepower. Its longevity and evolving capabilities prove why it still plays a major role in the plans of the United States Air Force.

In this video, we explore:

- The true power and payload capability of the B-52
- How modern upgrades have extended its combat effectiveness
- The advanced weapons it can deploy in modern warfare
- Why the bomber is expected to remain operational for decades

Chapters:
00:00 - Intro
01:19 - The Machine That Refused to Die
03:39 - The Arsenal Inside the Bomb Bay
05:52 - Operation Epic Fury (B-52 in Combat 2026)
07:53 - The B-52J Upgrade and Future
11:21 - Fleet, Legacy, and Combat Record
14:29 - Why the B-52 Is Still Irreplaceable
16:13 - Conclusion
